title: How did Ravens coach Jesse Minter end up rapping Eminem for the team? Inside Baltimore’s culture shift, where young play-callers are more than just young

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: How did Ravens coach Jesse Minter end up rapping Eminem for the team? Inside Baltimore’s culture shift, where young play-callers are more than just young
sources.description: After 18 years with John Harbaugh as the Ravens head coach, a new and needed energy shift has arrived. That’s by design. It’s not a knock on Harbaugh, but sometimes messages lose their edge and disciples are more willing to listen to a new source.
